cards.name: A New Hope
cards.text:
Requirements: Obtain Civilight Eterna.

Bonus: Passive: When obtaining a fabled card, you may choose to add the card listed in its obtain ability to your hand.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Too few cards to use
cards.text:
Requirements: For 3 consecutive rounds, start the turn with less than 8 cards in your hand. If you are the first player, the first round does not count.

Bonus: Passive: You may replace operators and field arts on your side of the field if there are no available spots to summon operators or summons. Draw 1 additional card at the start of every turn.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Sleeping Dragon
cards.text:
Requirements: For 5 consecutive rounds, your location’s ability should not activate (a passive effect triggering considers as an activation)

Bonus: Passive: Your location has no cost or requirements, and may be activated twice per round. You may activate your opponent’s location once per round.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Rainbows
cards.text: Requirements: When you obtain this card, reveal it to your opponent. At the start of your turn, if there are a total of 5 or more cards with coloured names (white names are not counted) in your graveyard, gain 6 DP, draw 1 card and deal 3 damage to your opponent. Then, discard this quest card and get a random quest card not yet obtained.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: One Mission
cards.text:
Requirements: Have 4 operators on field or in hand at one time which shares a class.

Bonus: Passive: Your cards cost 1 DP less, up to a minimum of 0 DP. When you play a factionless card, you may choose to retreat a card sharing its class on the field.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Healing
cards.text:
Requirements: Heal a total of 9 HP from cards on the field (Stolen or any healed HP above the maximum HP limit is not included in this calculation.)

Bonus: Passive: For every 3 HP you heal, deal 1 damage to your opponent.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Gone Forever
cards.text:
Requirements: Destroy and/or Neutralise 6 cards which are in your opponent’s hand.

Bonus: Passive: At the start of your turn, 1 random card in your opponent’s hand is sent to the graveyard. If that card is an operator, your opponent loses 1 HP. If the card is a field arts, that card is neutralised instead.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Gambling
cards.text: Requirements: When you obtain this card, reveal it to your opponent. At the start of your turn, roll 2 d6 dice. If both dice are a 5 or higher, steal 2 cards of your choice from your opponent’s graveyard and 1 card on your opponent’s field.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Doesn't Hurt To Be Prepared
cards.text:
Requirements: Use equip 4 times

Bonus: Passive: All of your controlled operators additionally have Manual equip. When cards which have more than 2 equipped operators are sent to the graveyard, you may instead neutralise 2 equipped operators instead.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Close to death? Or life?
cards.text:
Requirements: For 4 consecutive rounds, start the turn with less than 10 HP.

Bonus: Instant: You may choose to heal up to 5 HP.
Bonus: Passive: Every round, you may choose to take 3 damage to target and destroy an operator (this is considered as an Arts effect), or take 2 damage to randomly destroy 1 card in your opponent’s hand.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Arts
cards.text:
Requirements: Play a total of 6 Field Arts

Bonus: Passive: At the end of your turn, if your opponent has a field arts in their hand, they reveal their whole hand to you.
Bonus: Active: You may choose to destroy any 1 field arts on the field.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker

cards.name: Army
cards.text:
Requirements: At the start of 5 consecutive rounds, have a non-sleeping operator on your field. Summons are not considered operators for this calculation.

Bonus: React: Can only be used once per turn. Target the enemy and lower it’s attack and defense by 3 until the end of the turn. If this ability is used against a target with more than 4 attack, draw a card.
cards.source: made in the TACG card maker
